subtitles.en: I think the strategy that we implemented almost 10 years ago that was focusing on to health and wellness. We have almost focused all of our brands, our three macro brands, which is biostimes, where disaster was.

subtitles.en: We believe that is the key underlining factor for us, right? We continue to invest in science and to all of men. If you look at in particular for our infant will formula business, the reason we have able to perform so fast is because of a speak to market and the innovation that we're bringing.
subtitles.zh: 我们相信这是关键因素。我们持续投入科学研发。特别是婴幼儿配方奶粉业务，之所以能快速表现，是因为我们贴近市场并持续创新。

subtitles.en: Our biggest disruption has been the launch of HMO. Human will always sacrifice infant formula business. We have the only imported brand in China to bring that product into the market, which is driving our end consumption state.
subtitles.zh: 我们最大的突破是推出了HMO产品。我们是唯一在中国市场推出该产品的进口品牌，这推动了我们的终端消费。

subtitles.en: As you know, that you know for infant formula, the first six months are very critical. In stage one, we had a growth rate of 68.8 percentage point. We added almost 500,000 new mothers in the first half, which is the benchmark.
subtitles.zh: 如您所知，婴幼儿配方奶粉的前六个月非常关键。在第一阶段，我们的增长率达到68.8个百分点。上半年新增近50万新妈妈，这是基准。

subtitles.en: So our continuous focus on education superior products are delivering that. And even in Swiss, we are now downgrading. We are criminalizing the portfolio.
subtitles.zh: 我们持续专注于消费者教育和优质产品，这正在带来成果。即使在Swisse，我们也在优化产品组合。

subtitles.en: We are going against the market defining trends of launching higher ASP niche category products to expand our address market. Our average ASP is 2000 RMP for the innovations.
subtitles.zh: 我们逆势推出更高ASP的细分品类产品，以扩大市场。创新产品的平均ASP为2000元。

subtitles.en: And they contribute to 10.6% of NSR in the last 12 months. So that will say is the superior execution our innovative approach and better marketing is driving the best in class results.

subtitles.en: What is sort of the pricing environment now when it comes to infant formula? Because I think, you know, it's been quite competitive. And I think we've seen some of your peers in China, for example, have had to really, I've seen a contraction in their margins, just given the pricing environment now.
subtitles.zh: 目前婴幼儿配方奶粉的定价环境如何？竞争相当激烈，我们看到一些同行在中国市场因定价环境而利润率收缩。

subtitles.en: I mean, how are you in some ways navigating around the sort of change in the industry? I mean, what is the pricing environment now and look like to you?
subtitles.zh: 您是如何应对行业变化的？您眼中的定价环境是怎样的？

subtitles.en: It's a fair question, right? Like I said, we are not a price-led brand. Most of our growth is coming in the form of volume-led growth. We operate into the super premium segment. We are not into the mid-tier or the mastery, right?
subtitles.zh: 问得好。如我所说，我们不是价格导向的品牌。我们的增长主要来自销量驱动。我们专注于超高端市场，不涉足中端或大众市场。

subtitles.en: Because we believe a consumer education is a key to success, right? So in this first half, our super premium market share reached an all-time high of 20.6% percentage point compared to 14.8% for the same period last year.
subtitles.zh: 因为我们相信消费者教育是成功的关键。上半年，我们在超高端市场的份额达到历史新高20.6%，而去年同期为14.8%。
en_highlights: market share reached an all-time high of 20.6%

subtitles.en: So we're not downgrading it. We are, in fact, one of the fastest-going brands into the super premium segment.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们没有降级，事实上，我们是超高端市场中增长最快的品牌之一。

subtitles.en: And even in the Swiss, our adult nutrition care business, we are increasing percentage contribution from premiumization of our portfolio that is helping us to hit a higher cross margin threshold and invest more into marketing.
subtitles.zh: 即使在Swisse，我们的成人营养护理业务，也在提高高端产品组合的贡献，这帮助我们达到更高的毛利率门槛，并增加营销投入。

subtitles.en: So we have taken an approach that our differentiation will come in the form of consumer education, then downgrading of consumers.
subtitles.zh: 因此，我们的差异化策略是通过消费者教育，而不是消费者降级。

subtitles.en: Right. You have a very unique perspective into demographic trends. I'm not sure how to phrase this question, right?
subtitles.zh: 您对人口趋势有独特的见解。我不知道该怎么问这个问题。

subtitles.en: So it's it's, you know, do people are people having more babies or we've seen the trend people having babies later in life, if not known to babies, but let's get a pet.
subtitles.zh: 人们是生更多孩子，还是我们看到趋势是晚育，甚至不生孩子而养宠物？

subtitles.en: What trends are you seeing between one against the other? Am I over? I've read some articles around that and I wonder if I'm overthinking that.
subtitles.zh: 您如何看待这两种趋势的对比？我读过一些文章，想知道我是否想多了。

subtitles.en: Is the pet economy growing quicker than the infant economy is what I'm trying to get to here?
subtitles.zh: 我想问的是，宠物经济是否比婴儿经济增长更快？

subtitles.en: Sure. I mean, I think David, there is no good or bad industry, right? There are good and bad operators, right?
subtitles.zh: 当然。David，我认为没有好行业或坏行业，只有好的和坏的经营者。

subtitles.en: So it depends upon what strategy that you want to focus, right? Yes, you're right. The global birth rate is not increasing, right?
subtitles.zh: 这取决于你聚焦什么战略。是的，全球出生率并没有上升。
en_highlights: global birth rate is not increasing

subtitles.en: And that's not in one market. This is across the phenomenon, right? The fertility rates are down, right?
subtitles.zh: 这不是单一市场现象，而是全球现象。生育率在下降。

subtitles.en: But that doesn't mean that the infant formula market is not very attractive. It still remains how you get closer to the family, right?
subtitles.zh: 但这并不意味着婴幼儿配方奶粉市场没有吸引力。它仍然是如何更贴近家庭的问题。

subtitles.en: You build your trust into that, right? And biostat has done a relatively very good job in China and also the work that we've done into the French market, right?
subtitles.zh: 你建立信任。Biostime在中国做得很好，我们在法国市场也做了很多工作。

subtitles.en: With majority of our production for biostat happens. But your right pet adoption rate is increasing, right?
subtitles.zh: Biostime的大部分生产都在法国。但你说得对，宠物收养率在上升。

subtitles.en: Since COVID, we have seen the trend remaining. It is not accelerating, it is stabilizing it.
subtitles.zh: 自疫情以来，这一趋势持续，没有加速，而是趋于稳定。

subtitles.en: So yes, from a demographic perspective, yes, both rates will remain flat and will not grow to the level what it used to be.
subtitles.zh: 从人口角度看，出生率和收养率都将保持平稳，不会恢复到过去的水平。

subtitles.en: But pet adoption, they are becoming part of the family. They are treating them as their own babies, right?
subtitles.zh: 但宠物正在成为家庭的一部分，人们把它们当作自己的孩子。
en_highlights: treating them as their own babies

subtitles.en: The fur babies or the pet and so we do see this trend more following from North America into other markets as well.
subtitles.zh: 毛孩子或宠物，我们看到这一趋势从北美蔓延到其他市场。

subtitles.en: So that's why we said we have to drive the overall revenue contribution for our pet nutrition care business, which is low double digit to closer to 20%.
subtitles.zh: 因此，我们必须推动宠物营养护理业务的营收贡献从低两位数提升至接近20%。

subtitles.en: So that demographic share, the underlying adoption rate, will be the key underlying factors for the growth.
subtitles.zh: 人口结构变化和潜在的收养率将是增长的关键因素。

subtitles.en: Just tell us what's unique about it. How do you, as an assure like yourself, how do you compete to be like, you know, with the other private banks out there?
subtitles.zh: 它有何独特之处？作为保险公司，你如何与私人银行竞争？

subtitles.en: I think we partner very closely with the private banks and the international focus for this market space. And on the private banks, we have relationship with private banks for the past decade, so we build on that strength.
subtitles.zh: 我们与私人银行紧密合作，并聚焦国际市场。过去十年我们与私行建立了关系，在此基础上发展。

subtitles.en: But international focus, if you look at the last year, we actually double up, and these are the key channels for the handnet worth.
subtitles.zh: 在国际聚焦方面，去年我们翻倍增长，这些是高净值业务的关键渠道。

subtitles.en: And when it comes to handnet worth, you need to have a product suite that covers both the saving space, which Hong Kong is very good at, and but also in protection space.
subtitles.zh: 高净值客户需要涵盖储蓄和保障两方面的产品组合，香港在储蓄方面很强。

subtitles.en: This is something that Singapore might be doing well, but in Hong Kong, we should be catching up, and to have that range of product position and the service, and the presence in Hong Kong and Singapore in Bermuda, and in the future in other locations.
subtitles.zh: 新加坡在保障方面做得不错，香港需要追赶。我们将在香港、新加坡、百慕大等地布局，未来拓展更多地区。

subtitles.en: What's unique about that specific segment of handnet worth? In other words, what does that group need that largely exists only with that group that you don't get across the different parts of your franchise?
subtitles.zh: 高净值群体的独特需求是什么？他们需要哪些其他群体没有的服务？

subtitles.en: In other words, how much money does that have? And is that something that you might look to replicate elsewhere?
subtitles.zh: 他们的资金规模如何？这种模式会复制到其他市场吗？

subtitles.en: So for handnet worth, if you look at in total business now, it's about 9% of business, so it's not small. Of total. So it's quite important and growing.
subtitles.zh: 高净值业务目前占总业务的9%，规模不小，且持续增长。

subtitles.en: And what important for this segment of clients is they have a very specific need that the financial planning, the legacy protection, so it's very different than the mass market, the mass affluent market.
subtitles.zh: 这类客户有特定需求，如财务规划和传承保障，与大众富裕市场截然不同。

subtitles.en: So your product set and your service, the white glove service that you always have to be very different. And the fact that we need to build a global network in order to follow the sun kind of model.
subtitles.zh: 因此产品和服务必须高度定制化，提供白手套服务。我们需要构建全球网络，实现“跟随太阳”模式。

subtitles.en: So we're always on for this kind segment, it's really important. So recently we just hired very senior people to come in and build what we call the global handnet worth business for us.
subtitles.zh: 这个细分市场非常重要。最近我们聘请了资深人士来打造全球高净值业务。

title_lines: 中国互联网AI投入短期承压

subtitles.en: It's both at this point, but we do think that, you know, given where the Chinese valuation is, it is a structural opportunity as well.
subtitles.zh: 目前两者兼有，但考虑到中国市场的估值水平，我们认为这也是一个结构性机会。

subtitles.en: I mean, I think the China Internet names, for example, the AI plays are going through a pretty volatile time.
subtitles.zh: 比如中国互联网企业，尤其是AI相关标的，正经历一段波动较大的时期。

subtitles.en: We have seen quite a fair bit of self-off post-earning seasons from Tencent and Alibaba as well.
subtitles.zh: 腾讯和阿里巴巴在财报季之后也出现了不少抛售。

subtitles.en: As what you are seeing with these companies is that they are using the free cash flow to really accelerate their investment in AI KPEX for future growth.
subtitles.zh: 这些公司正利用自由现金流加速AI资本开支，为未来增长布局。

subtitles.en: And I think what's interesting behind that is that we are seeing better payback periods as well from the KPEX they are making as they are able to start monetizing their cloud revenue and earning higher margins.
subtitles.zh: 有趣的是，这些资本开支的回报周期在改善，因为他们开始将云业务收入变现，利润率也在提升。

subtitles.en: But I think at this point what we are seeing is that investors don't really like the story that you are using your free cash flow to actually seeing that short-term impact on their earnings.
subtitles.zh: 但目前投资者似乎不太认可这种用自由现金流投入、短期影响盈利的做法。

subtitles.en: And that, I think, represents an interesting opportunity for us, and I do think that is a fair bit of a contrarian call for us at this point in time as well.
subtitles.zh: 这反而为我们提供了有趣的入场机会，我认为当前时点这是一个相当逆向的观点。

subtitles.en: Yes, so from a broader perspective, we have been hedging ourselves a bit in a sense that as we are adding to the AI trade, whether you look at us adding more to the China Internet names as they get so off by the market, but we are still positive about the longer-term trajectory and the strategy that the both companies are taking.
subtitles.zh: 从更广的视角看，我们一直在做一定对冲。比如在AI交易中，我们增持了中国互联网公司，尽管市场抛售，但我们对其长期轨迹和公司战略仍持乐观态度。

subtitles.en: We are also adding more to the likes of financials, for example, where earnings have also been relatively resilient, and some of the consumer stocks also have pretty high dividend use.
subtitles.zh: 我们也在增持金融类公司，它们的盈利相对稳健，一些消费类公司的股息率也较高。

subtitles.en: So a bit of a well-strategy there, where we are invested in both the high dividend use stocks in China, but also the growth stocks like China Internet.
subtitles.zh: 这是一种均衡策略，既配置中国高股息标的，也配置中国互联网等成长型标的。

subtitles.en: And within this, when you talk about the AI trade, we have also been doing quite a fair bit of what you call China AI localization play, investing in the KPEX equipments.
subtitles.zh: 在AI交易中，我们也在做所谓的中国AI本土化布局，投资于资本开支相关的设备领域。

subtitles.en: As we know that when we look at and connect the dots, companies are really uping their game with regard to KPEX, and therefore we would want to be part of that supply chain story in China as well.
subtitles.zh: 我们看到企业确实在加大资本开支，因此我们也希望参与中国这一供应链的故事。

subtitles.en: Yes, so I think, and again, back to the earning season as we are in the midst of it, but as we go through the earnings of our Indian companies, I think what's standing out quite clear this time, which we have not seen for many quarters actually, is the positive earnings revisions and growth that is starting to come off India after a very long period of a tough times as India went through some of its macro challenges and inflation, et cetera, et cetera.
subtitles.zh: 是的，回到财报季，我们在审视印度公司财报时，这次明显看到盈利上修和增长，这是多个季度以来首次，此前印度经历了较长时间的宏观挑战和通胀压力。

subtitles.en: So this time, I think the key change is that we are seeing a change in fundamentals and earnings is really starting to come back.
subtitles.zh: 这次的关键变化是基本面改善，盈利真的开始回升。

subtitles.en: And therefore, we do think that as foreigners have gone out of India for quite a fair bit, it is a good time to be adding back and picking up the quality stocks that we like.
subtitles.zh: 因此，鉴于外资此前大量流出印度，我们认为现在是重新加仓、挑选优质标的的好时机。

subtitles.en: You might ask us what are the stocks that we like. Starting with the financials, it is a good place to play.
subtitles.zh: 你可能会问我们看好哪些方向。首先金融板块是一个不错的切入点。

subtitles.en: The valuation remains relatively attractive. It has gone through a deal rating as well. Yes, it's going to be more expensive than Chinese banks, but growth is also going to be higher.
subtitles.zh: 估值仍相对有吸引力，也经历了估值重估。虽然比中国内地的银行贵，但增长也更高。

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
